pinyin: shí ér bù zhī qí wèi
literal: eat · yet · not · know · its · taste

meaning.en: So preoccupied that one doesn't notice what one is doing.
meaning.zh: 吃东西却尝不出味道，形容心思不在这里。

examples.zh: 他心里惦记着考试结果，食而不知其味。
examples.en: Worried about his exam results, he ate without tasting a thing.

examples.zh: 失恋后她整天食而不知其味。
examples.en: After the break-up she went through the days without tasting her food.

examples.zh: 心不在焉，食而不知其味。
examples.en: When the mind is absent, one eats without knowing the taste.

story.en: The Great Learning: 'When the mind is not present, we look but do not see, listen but do not hear, eat but do not know the taste' (心不在焉，视而不见，听而不闻，食而不知其味).
story.zh: 《大学》：“心不在焉，视而不见，听而不闻，食而不知其味。”

usage.en: Literary; often after 心不在焉.
usage.zh: 书面语，常与“心不在焉”连用。

meaning.zh: 华丽的衣服和漂亮的饰品。

examples.zh: 晚宴上宾客们华服美饰，光彩照人。
examples.en: At the banquet the guests were in their finery, dazzling to see.

examples.zh: 她不追求华服美饰，只穿简单的衣服。
examples.en: She doesn't care for finery and wears simple clothes.

usage.zh: 描写性说法，多用于书面。

meaning.zh: 破旧的衣服。

examples.zh: 那个乞丐穿着破衣烂衫。
examples.en: The beggar was dressed in rags.

examples.zh: 小时候家里穷，常穿哥哥的破衣烂衫。
examples.en: We were poor when I was little, and I often wore my brother's tattered hand-me-downs.

meaning.en: Plain clothes of coarse cloth; a simple life.
meaning.zh: 粗布、麻布做的衣服，指朴素的穿着。

examples.zh: 他身穿粗布麻衣，却气度不凡。
examples.en: He wore plain homespun, yet had a striking bearing.

examples.zh: 过去农民大多粗布麻衣，生活简朴。
examples.en: In the past most farmers wore coarse clothes and lived simply.

usage.en: Neutral or approving, for simplicity rather than poverty.
usage.zh: 中性或褒义，侧重朴素而非贫穷。

meaning.zh: 穿布衣，吃素食，形容生活俭朴。

examples.zh: 他官居高位，却一生布衣蔬食。
examples.en: Though he held high office, he lived simply all his life.

examples.zh: 老先生布衣蔬食，把积蓄都捐给了学校。
examples.en: The old gentleman lived frugally and gave all his savings to the school.

natural: a thorn hairpin and cloth skirt

meaning.zh: 用荆枝作钗，粗布作裙，形容妇女装束朴素。

examples.zh: 她虽荆钗布裙，却掩不住清秀的容貌。
examples.en: Though plainly dressed, she couldn't hide her fine looks.

examples.zh: 祖母年轻时荆钗布裙，勤俭持家。
examples.en: In her youth Grandmother dressed simply and ran a frugal household.

usage.en: Literary, of women. Traditionally linked with Meng Guang, the frugal wife of Liang Hong.
usage.zh: 书面语，形容妇女。传统上与梁鸿之妻孟光相联系。

meaning.en: Mending and patching clothes; frugal household chores.
meaning.zh: 缝补衣物，形容节俭持家。

examples.zh: 妈妈晚上总是在灯下缝缝补补。
examples.en: In the evenings Mum was always mending clothes under the lamp.

examples.zh: 那时候一件衣服缝缝补补穿好几年。
examples.en: Back then one garment was patched and worn for years.

examples.zh: 这个制度缝缝补补，问题还是很多。
examples.en: The system has been patched up again and again, but there are still many problems.

meaning.zh: 衣服单薄，饮食微薄，形容生活贫困。

examples.zh: 那年冬天，难民们衣单食薄，处境艰难。
examples.en: That winter the refugees were ill-clad and ill-fed.

examples.zh: 他自幼衣单食薄，却发奋读书。
examples.en: Poorly fed and clothed from childhood, he studied hard.

meaning.zh: 穿粗布衣，吃粗劣的饭，形容生活艰苦。

examples.zh: 他早年粗衣恶食，备尝艰辛。
examples.en: In his early years he lived on rough food and clothing and knew every hardship.

examples.zh: 创业时他们粗衣恶食，毫无怨言。
examples.en: When starting out they lived frugally without complaint.

usage.en: Literary. 恶 here means 'poor quality', not 'evil'.

meaning.en: Honest and true to one's word.
meaning.zh: 为人诚实，遵守信用。

examples.zh: 做生意要诚实守信。
examples.en: In business you must be honest and keep your word.

examples.zh: 诚实守信是做人的根本。
examples.en: Honesty and keeping faith are the foundation of character.

usage.en: A core value in moral education and business.

meaning.zh: 乐意帮助别人。

equivalents: always ready to lend a hand

examples.zh: 他热情开朗，乐于助人。
examples.en: He's warm, cheerful and always ready to help.

examples.zh: 我们班评选乐于助人的好同学。
examples.en: Our class is choosing the most helpful classmate.

meaning.zh: 心肠好，为人善良。

examples.zh: 奶奶心地善良，常常帮助邻居。
examples.en: Grandma is kind-hearted and often helps the neighbours.

examples.zh: 他虽然脾气急，但心地善良。
examples.en: He's quick-tempered, but has a heart of gold.

meaning.zh: 忠诚可靠，诚实本分。

examples.zh: 他忠诚老实，深得老板信任。
examples.en: He's loyal and honest and has his boss's full trust.

examples.zh: 这只狗忠诚老实，一直守在门口。
examples.en: The dog is loyal and steady and always guards the door.

meaning.en: Upright and refusing to curry favour.
meaning.zh: 为人正直，不逢迎附和。

examples.zh: 这位法官正直不阿，从不徇私。
examples.en: The judge is upright and never shows favouritism.

examples.zh: 他正直不阿，得罪了不少人。
examples.en: His uncompromising honesty offended quite a few people.

usage.en: 阿 is ē (to flatter). The common set phrase is 刚正不阿.
usage.zh: “阿”读ē，意为迎合。常用“刚正不阿”。

meaning.zh: 阴毒险恶，狡猾奸诈。

examples.zh: 小说里的反派阴险狡诈。
examples.en: The novel's villain is treacherous and sly.

examples.zh: 这种阴险狡诈的人一定要提防。
examples.en: You must be wary of such scheming people.

meaning.zh: 不真诚，故意装出来。

examples.zh: 他的热情太虚伪做作了。
examples.en: His friendliness is so fake.

examples.zh: 我讨厌虚伪做作的客套话。
examples.en: I can't stand phoney polite talk.

meaning.zh: 懒惰已经成了习性。

examples.zh: 他懒惰成性，什么家务都不做。
examples.en: He's bone idle and does no housework at all.

examples.zh: 懒惰成性的人很难有所成就。
examples.en: Habitually lazy people rarely achieve anything.

usage.en: Criticism; X成性 means 'X has become second nature'.

meaning.en: Petty and intolerant; unable to let things go.
meaning.zh: 气量小，容不下人和事。

examples.zh: 他心胸狭窄，一点小事就记仇。
examples.en: He's petty and holds a grudge over the smallest thing.

examples.zh: 心胸狭隘的人很难与人合作。
examples.en: Narrow-minded people find it hard to work with others.

synonyms: 武大郎开店——比我高的不要

meaning.en: Petty and narrow-minded, fussing over trifles.
meaning.zh: 比喻气量狭小，只考虑小事。

examples.zh: 别那么小肚鸡肠，他不是故意的。
examples.en: Don't be so petty; he didn't mean it.

examples.zh: 这人鼠肚鸡肠，一句玩笑也开不得。
examples.en: He's so thin-skinned you can't even joke with him.

examples.zh: 我不是鸡肠狗肚的人。
examples.en: I'm not a petty person.

usage.en: Casual. Older forms: 鼠肚鸡肠, 鸡肠狗肚.
usage.zh: 口语。也作“鼠肚鸡肠”“鸡肠狗肚”。

meaning.zh: 冷漠残酷，毫无感情。

examples.zh: 他对待下属冷酷无情。
examples.en: He treats his staff heartlessly.

examples.zh: 战争冷酷无情，夺去了无数生命。
examples.en: War is ruthless and has taken countless lives.

usage.en: For people, also abstractions like war or fate.
usage.zh: 可指人，也可指战争、命运等。

antonyms: 对待同志要像春天般温暖

natural: sow in spring, reap in autumn

meaning.en: The farming cycle; effort brings its reward in time.
meaning.zh: 春天播种，秋天收获，泛指农事，也比喻付出终有回报。

examples.zh: 农民春种秋收，一年忙到头。
examples.en: Farmers sow in spring and reap in autumn, busy all year.

examples.zh: 学习也是春种秋收，今天的努力会有回报。
examples.en: Study is like farming: today's effort will pay off.

synonyms: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦

text: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦
pinyin: shéi zhī pán zhōng cān, lì lì jiē xīn kǔ
literal: who · knows · plate · in · meal · grain · grain · all · toil
natural: who knows that every grain on the plate came from toil

meaning.en: Every grain of food is the fruit of hard work; don't waste it.
meaning.zh: 盘中的每一粒粮食都来之不易，要珍惜。

examples.zh: 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦，别浪费粮食。
examples.en: Every grain is hard-won — don't waste food.

examples.zh: 奶奶常用“粒粒皆辛苦”教育我们光盘。
examples.en: Grandma used 'every grain is toil' to teach us to clear our plates.

examples.zh: 每次剩饭，妈妈都会念一句“粒粒皆辛苦”。
examples.en: Whenever we leave food, Mum reminds us that every grain is hard-won.

story.en: Li Shen's short poem 'Pity the Peasants': 'Hoeing grain at noon, sweat drips to the soil below. Who knows that of the meal on the plate, every grain is bitter toil?'
story.zh: 李绅《悯农》：“锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土。谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦。”

usage.en: Learned by every Chinese child; used to discourage waste.
usage.zh: 几乎人人会背，常用来劝人节约粮食。

synonyms: 锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土

pinyin: miàn cháo huáng tǔ bèi cháo tiān
literal: face · towards · yellow · earth · back · towards · sky
natural: face to the soil, back to the sky

meaning.en: The hard life of a farmer toiling in the fields.
meaning.zh: 形容农民在田里辛苦劳作。

examples.zh: 父母面朝黄土背朝天，供我上了大学。
examples.en: My parents toiled in the fields to put me through university.

examples.zh: 他不想一辈子面朝黄土背朝天。
examples.en: He didn't want to spend his life doing backbreaking farm work.

usage.zh: 多带同情，形容农村劳作。

synonyms: 锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土
